ICS 45C Week 6: Inheritance & Polymorphism

This is a sample rendered preview that mimics the md-editor output. Try each export option to see how it handles headings, code, math, lists, and Chinese text.

1. Class Inheritance

In C++, a derived class inherits from a base class using the colon syntax. Access modifiers (public, protected, private) control how members are inherited.

class Shape {
public:
    virtual double area() const = 0;
    virtual ~Shape() = default;
};

class Circle : public Shape {
    double r;
public:
    Circle(double r) : r(r) {}
    double area() const override { return 3.14159 * r * r; }
};

2. Polymorphism with Virtual Functions

Virtual functions enable runtime polymorphism via the vtable mechanism. The integral of a Gaussian is a classic example:

∫−∞∞e−x2dx=π

Key takeaways

  • Polymorphism 让基类指针调用派生类方法
  • 每个含 virtual 函数的类都有一张 vtable
  • 对象首字段是 vptr（指向类的 vtable）
Tip：使用 override 关键字让编译器帮你检查虚函数签名是否匹配基类。

实现要点：
• Copy HTML / Download HTML — 直接序列化 preview innerHTML
• Print → PDF — window.print() + @media print CSS（隐藏 toolbar / nav 只留 preview）
• Download PDF — 按需 CDN 加载 html2pdf.js（~150 KB），点击才下载，不增加初始页面大小
• 菜单关闭：点外部 / 点选项 / Esc

感受一下：试试 4 个选项。Print 那个会弹打印对话框；Download PDF 会真的生成 .pdf 让你下载；Copy / Download HTML 各自做你能想到的事。
